subject: English
question_text: Choose the best answer from the alternatives.
stimulus: a. Lipi and his sisters are ⎯ in number. (i) three (ii) four (iii) five (iv) six b. Lipi wanted to pursue her education. Here ‘pursue’ means ⎯. (i) discontinue (ii) stop (iii) cut off (iv) prosecute c. Her father arranged her marriage with the son of a ⎯. (i) teacher (ii) farmer (iii) driver (iv) fisherman d. Tara Mia was a widower. Here widower means a man ⎯. (i) who has recently married (ii) whose wife had died and married again (iii) who has two wives (iv) whose wife has died and not married again e. Father of Lipi is was a ⎯. (i) day labourer (ii) shopkeeper (iii) photographer (iv) painter f. The story of Lipi is told by ⎯. (i) Tara Mia (ii) Father of Lipi (iii) Headteacher (iv) Ms Choudhury g. Lipi’s mother was ⎯ to marry Lipi off. (i) willing (ii) unwilling (iii) happy (iv) crazy Extra Practices h. Tara Mia is a great bride because ⎯. (i) he is a widower (ii) he is rich (iii) he is illiterate (iv) he is a good farmer i. Lipi’s mother had to work ⎯ to maintain her family. (i) outside of her house (ii) inside of her house (iii) in the local market (iv) in the school j. Lipi’s ⎯ wanted to marry her off. (i) mother (ii) father (iii) father and mother (iv) headteacher
guide_solution: a. (i) three; b. (iv) prosecute; c. (ii) farmer; d. (iv) whose wife has died and not married again; e. (i) day labourer; f. (iv) Ms Choudhury; g. (ii) unwilling; h. (ii) he is rich; i. (i) outside of her house; j. (ii) father.

subject: English
stimulus: a. Who was Tara Mia? b. What is Lipi’s father? c. Who played role to stop Lipi’s marriage? d. Why was not Lipi ready to marry? e. How many brothers and sisters does Lipi have? Extra Practices f. What is Lipi’s mother? g. What was Tara Mia’s father? h. How old was Lipi the year before last? i. Where would she read? j. Who arranged her Marriage with Tara Mia?
guide_solution: a. Tara Mia was the only son of a farmer. He was a widower and illiterate but well off. b. Lipi’s father is a day labourer. c. Lipi’s Headteacher played role to stop her marriage. d. Lipi was not ready to marry as she wanted to pursue her studies. e. Lipi has two brothers and two sisters. f. Lipi’s mother is a homemaker and part-time worker. g. Tara Mia’s father was an influential farmer in the village. h. Lipi was 14 years old the year before last. i. She would read in a rural school in Rangpur. j. Father of Lipi arranged her marriage with Tara Mia.
